historyHelp.title: Umo Mungafumyira Mbiri ya Kusambira pa Intaneti Mwakuvikilirika
historyHelp.chromeInstructions: Tsegulani Menu (⋮) → History → Clear browsing data → sankhani "History" na "Cookies" → Clear data.
historyHelp.safariInstructions: Tsegulani pulogiramu ya Settings → Safari → Clear History and Website Data.
historyHelp.safetyNote: Ichi chikufumya mbiri ya kusambira pa intaneti pa chipangizo chinu, kweni chikufumya yayi ma record gha kampani ya foni panji uyo wakumupani Wi-Fi. Usange ntchakuvikilirika, gwiriskani ntchito foni ya mubwezi winu panji kompyuta ya ku laibulare ya ŵanthu wose.
